headline: Allentown School Board approves new 3-year superintendent contract
summary: The Allentown School Board voted 7-2 to approve a new three-year contract for Superintendent Maria Gonzalez. The contract includes a 3 percent annual raise and performance bonuses tied to graduation rates.

headline: Bethlehem zoning board approves 120-unit apartment complex on Stefko Boulevard
summary: The Bethlehem Zoning Board approved plans for a 120-unit apartment complex on Stefko Boulevard near Route 378. Developer Peron Group expects to break ground by September. Several residents spoke against the project, citing traffic concerns.

headline: Moravian Academy students win first place at state science fair
summary: A team of three Moravian Academy juniors won first place at the Pennsylvania State Science Fair with a project on microplastic filtration in the Lehigh River. The team advances to the national competition in July.
